user.title: Météo-France Radar
user.description: Paste your key for the Météo-France DPRadar API. It is checked against the API before the integration is added.

data_description.api_key: Generated on portail-api.meteofrance.fr after subscribing to the DPRadar API. Rain forecasts are optional: they also need the PIAF, AROME-PI and AROME APIs on the same key.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: Météo-France no longer accepts the current key, or it is about to expire. Paste a new one. The radar history already stored is kept.

data_description.api_key: Generated on portail-api.meteofrance.fr after subscribing to the DPRadar API. Rain forecasts are optional: they also need the PIAF, AROME-PI and AROME APIs on the same key.

reconfigure.title: Change the API key
reconfigure.description: Paste the new key. The radar history already stored is kept.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was refused by Météo-France.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Météo-France API.
error.key_expired: This API key has expired. Generate a new one on the Météo-France portal.

init.title: Storage
init.description: Radar frames are stored in this folder. Changing it does not move the frames already stored: the old folder is left as it is.

data_description.storage_path: Absolute path. Keep it outside /config so backups stay small.
data_description.size_cap_mb: When the frames go over this size, the oldest ones are removed first.

error.path_not_absolute: The path must be absolute (start with /).
error.path_not_writable: This folder cannot be created or written to.

confirm.title: Météo-France API key expires soon
confirm.description: The Météo-France API key expires on {expiry}. Generate a new key on the Météo-France portal, then submit to enter it. Without a new key, the radar stops updating on that day.

abort.entry_not_found: The Météo-France Radar integration is no longer set up.

forecast_forbidden.title: Météo-France key not subscribed to the {product} forecast API
forecast_forbidden.description: Météo-France refused the API key for {product} forecasts. On portail-api.meteofrance.fr, subscribe to the "{api}" API, then generate a new key: an existing key does not gain new subscriptions. Enter the new key through Reconfigure on the Météo-France Radar integration. Until then the radar keeps working and the cards show the forecasts they have.
